limitations: Additional reconstruction trials were absent from the historical bridge, but are not a prospectively held-out evaluation set.
The target is a complete-case linear adjusted contrast, not necessarily the published trial estimand.
Arm orientation is lexicographic label 2 minus label 1, with no inference of clinical control identity.
Empirical resamples are conditional on observed participants; source estimates are not population truth.
Bootstrap intervals resample trial summaries and describe this selected source panel; trials are not a random clinical population sample.
Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted across metrics; there is no significance-based pass criterion.
No language model was evaluated; model-agent transfer and clinical decision validity remain unevaluated.
The paired linkage permutation is an analysis control, not a competing synthetic-data generator.
10 of 10 trials in the separate age/BMI fidelity experiment overlap the historical bridge.
